name: prompt
label: Prompt
help: The question to ask, at most 4,000 characters. Pricing: https://serpkite.com/pricing. Failed, refused and empty answers are not billed.

name: web_search
label: Search the web
help: Let ChatGPT search the web before answering, as it does by default for logged-out visitors.

name: country
label: Country
help: Ask from this country (two-letter code, such as gb), so the answer is localized like a visitor's there.

name: track
label: Track
help: Up to 20 brands or domains (such as Pipedrive or hubspot.com). Mentions then says whether the answer names each one and whether a cited source is on it.
